notes.title: Halloween 2022
notes.notes:
Howl you doin'? Spooky or not here we come, you can't hide. Gonna find you and hunt it slowly! First one is limited summer-themed collection which can be obtained only during summer - from now till the end of August. Second one is new set of 'moticons stickers - Doodlemoticons. notes.title: Workshop, new stickers and more!
notes.notes:
Today we want to introduce you Workshop support for #monstercakes. Now you can post your stickers and they can be added to the game! Curated items are submitted to a review queue that other players can vote on, and then the developer will review, potentially accept the item, and then integrate it into the game. If accepted into the game, the item will also be added to the #monstercakes item store(that will be introduced with first accepted batch) and you will earn a cut of revenue from direct purchases. The item will also generally be added as a random item drop, and thus can be sold on the Steam Marketplace between players. 

    This update also contains two new sticker packs: Skulls and Emoticons. Skulls pack is availible as ingame drop and Emoticons collection pack can be obtained through token exchange.

    Token system also updated - now you can get up to four sticker packs with guaranteed two packs for exchange tokens! Chances to get rare packs are also increased.
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28350392/8f64b993cfe6d33cd473abfcd1a7e36f5641077c.png[/img] [img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28350392/baf5c8d2a2420ed5fb729afa4644437e05b9850c.png[/img]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28350392/ac4ce82e9234f32e580906d7d1561b6e60f260ce.png[/img][img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28350392/80f1b6d6cf99ea6ce1812d33d69f600ddf6df5b8.png[/img][img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28350392/e48e411825e512cb2b273a51977c714eebfddded.png[/img] 
Today's update introduces sticker recycling and crafting. Now you can recycle any sticker to Sticker Fragment, collect five of them and exchange it to one Sticker Token. Collect ten Sticker Tokens and craft it to random sticker pack with higher chances to get rare pack!
Also, this update contains three new sticker packs - Digits vol. 2, Monsterdigits and Spinner Sticker pack. Spinner collection is only availible through token exchange and have special effect ingame - you can press on sticker while playing and it will spin. Hold your mouse down on sticker and it will spins faster!
